prompt:
Create a polished 2048x1152 landscape blog cover for Foldpin, a native Mac desktop sticky-note product. Premium developer editorial graphic style: precise typography, subtle technical grid, restrained butter yellow and lavender accents, elegant connectors, finely detailed UI-inspired cards. Sophisticated and attractive, neither a plain flowchart nor generic glossy AI art. No plants, desk props, robots, glowing brains, dramatic 3D, or neon. Main title exactly "Foldpin" at upper left, subtitle "Small fragments. Lasting knowledge.". Strong visual hierarchy and generous margins.
CRITICAL COMPOSITION CHANGE: The central hero must be an unmistakable COMPUTER DESKTOP with MULTIPLE INDEPENDENT STICKY NOTE WINDOWS placed over a background app window, NOT one giant note, NOT a dashboard, NOT a kanban board. Show a miniature editor or browser as desktop background and 4 distinct notes freely placed over it: short syntax-colored code, 2-item checklist, a quick idea, and an audio waveform. Use small rounded corners, minimal titlebars, varied dimensions, one folded narrow note strip. At least one buttery yellow paper note and muted lavender/blue notes. The whole desktop is one broad scene boundary, subtly labeled "Your desktop" and "Foldpin". Remain legible and uncluttered, no dense microtext.
LEFT narrow zone: a few scattered fragments of code, links, ideas, image and voice flow into the central desktop via fine routing lines. RIGHT narrow zone: desktop notes feed into a compact organized knowledge collection labeled "Personal knowledge" with grouped cards "Ideas", "Projects", "References", then branch to output labels "Obsidian", "Markdown", "Other tools". Use understated violet line icons, no giant logos. Paths to future organization and outputs dashed; small label "Local AI · planned" between desktop and knowledge collection. Direction left-to-right unambiguous. Center desktop takes about half canvas width. Title takes top 15 percent, graphic takes main 70 percent. Bottom-right footer exactly "Future vision · Concept". Do not claim sync or released integrations. This is conceptual illustration, not an exact application screenshot. All English text clean, accurate, short. Produce a genuinely beautiful composed cover with confident typography, useful whitespace and layered native-style note windows.
ART DIRECTION FOR THIS VARIANT: Deep midnight charcoal background, subtle blue-gray grid, straight-on wide desktop hero with a dark code editor behind overlapping yellow, lilac and blue notes. Refined dark developer-tool aesthetic. No physical monitor frame. Tiny subtle shadows only. Warm yellow notes create the strongest focus.
